house.description: Burnsville; refundable sales and use tax exemption provided for construction materials for a city hall.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Taxes

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; sales and use; providing a refundable exemption for construction materials for construction of a city hall in the city of Burnsville.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+CITY OF BURNSVILLE; SALES TAX EXEMPTION FOR CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Exemption; refund.+]

[+(a) Materials and supplies used or consumed in and equipment incorporated into the construction, reconstruction, upgrade, expansion, renovation, or remodeling of a new city hall in the city of Burnsville are exempt from sales and use tax under Minnesota Statutes, chapter 297A, provided that the materials, supplies, and equipment are purchased after December 31, 2024, and before January 1, 2029. +]

[+(b) The tax must be imposed and collected as if the rate under Minnesota Statutes, section 297A.62, subdivisions 1 and 1a, applied, and then refunded in the same manner provided for projects under Minnesota Statutes, section 297A.75, subdivision 1, clause (17). Refunds for eligible purchases must not be issued until after June 30, 2025. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Appropriation.+]

[+The amount required to pay the refunds under subdivision 1 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of revenue. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective retroactively for sales and purchases made after December 31, 2024, and before January 1, 2029. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; sales and use; providing a refundable exemption for construction materials for construction of a city hall in the city of Burnsville.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. CITY OF BURNSVILLE; SALES TAX EXEMPTION FOR CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS.

Subdivision 1.

Exemption; refund.

(a) Materials and supplies used or consumed in and equipment incorporated into the construction, reconstruction, upgrade, expansion, renovation, or remodeling of a new city hall in the city of Burnsville are exempt from sales and use tax under Minnesota Statutes, chapter 297A, provided that the materials, supplies, and equipment are purchased after December 31, 2024, and before January 1, 2029.

(b) The tax must be imposed and collected as if the rate under Minnesota Statutes, section 297A.62, subdivisions 1 and 1a, applied, and then refunded in the same manner provided for projects under Minnesota Statutes, section 297A.75, subdivision 1, clause (17). Refunds for eligible purchases must not be issued until after June 30, 2025.

Subd. 2.

Appropriation.

The amount required to pay the refunds under subdivision 1 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of revenue.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective retroactively for sales and purchases made after December 31, 2024, and before January 1, 2029.
